name: jungle-falls
description: A tall jungle pane: terraced waterfalls wind down into a lily pool, and animals drop by at random - toucans, parrots, a swinging monkey, a jaguar, a crocodile, a frog, butterflies, a sloth.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the labels and descriptions this mod shows: en (English) or ko (한국어)
